entities.name: @okie/web
entities.responsibility: React browser shell that renders the C4 atlas, plays deterministic guided stories, and hosts the inspector, source viewer, and paste-a-repo landing.

entities.name: src/App.tsx
entities.responsibility: Application shell: canvas viewport, inspector, story chrome, Ask Atlas, and isolate/step navigation.

entities.name: src/ask/askAtlas.ts
entities.responsibility: Ask Atlas client that bounds the question to selected or isolated packets and posts /api/ask without submitting when disconnected.

entities.name: src/cameraFlightController.ts
entities.responsibility: Animates camera flights between story steps and framed selections.

entities.name: src/diagram/SourceViewer.tsx
entities.responsibility: Source tab viewer for code entities with frozen excerpts or source refs; containers stay sourceless.

entities.name: src/hostedAtlas.ts
entities.responsibility: Public /r/<owner>/<repo> atlas identity, including the THISS/okie dogfood share URL.

entities.name: src/inspector/inspectorPanel.ts
entities.responsibility: Inspector width, Source vs Details tab policy, and inspectorAcceptedSummary for gated enrichment prose.

entities.name: src/main.tsx
entities.responsibility: Browser entry that bootstraps fonts and mounts the atlas, including the scan-fixture load path.

entities.name: src/minimap.tsx
entities.responsibility: Overview minimap for panning the atlas canvas.

entities.name: src/navigation/historyController.ts
entities.responsibility: Browser history adapter that round-trips canonical navigation URLs.

entities.name: src/navigation/navigationState.ts
entities.responsibility: Canonical URL-backed navigation state for camera, selection, isolate, and story step.

entities.name: src/provenance/presentation.ts
entities.responsibility: Presents claim origin (observed / inferred / ai-explanation) and evidence counts.

entities.name: src/renderer/Canvas2DRenderer.ts
entities.responsibility: CPU Canvas2D fallback renderer used when WebGPU/WebGL2 are unavailable.

entities.name: src/renderer/createRenderer.ts
entities.responsibility: Picks WASM, Canvas2D, or unsupported renderer backends for the atlas canvas.

entities.name: src/renderer/query.ts
entities.responsibility: Parses demo query params including fixture=scan and per-repo scan slugs.

entities.name: src/renderer/scanFixture.ts
entities.responsibility: Loads and validates the gitignored fixtures/scan trio for ?fixture=scan.

entities.name: src/renderer/WasmRendererAdapter.ts
entities.responsibility: Frozen WASM import boundary: default-inits atlas-wasm and wraps createAtlasRenderer.

entities.name: src/scanLanding.tsx
entities.responsibility: Paste-a-repo landing that submits a GitHub URL and reports scan/enrichment job progress.

entities.name: src/semantic/semanticLens.ts
entities.responsibility: Maps camera zoom onto C4 semantic bands (context, container, component, code).

entities.name: src/storyFocus.ts
entities.responsibility: Computes which entities and relations a story step should select and highlight.

entities.name: src/storyFraming.ts
entities.responsibility: Frames the camera around the current story step’s revealed entities.

entities.name: src/storyPlayback.ts
entities.responsibility: Guided-story playback runtime: play, pause, jump, and camera flights between steps.

entities.name: src/webmcp.ts
entities.responsibility: In-page WebMCP provider exposing atlas tools (level, select, isolate, tour, ask) to the browser.

entities.name: inspectorAcceptedSummary
entities.responsibility: Returns trimmed enrichment responsibility text for the inspector, ignoring blank or placeholder copy.
